about_short_description.short_description: STUDIO is a web design & development platform that enables users to build websites from scratch without coding.

product.name: Studio.Design
product.description: A no-code web design and development platform that allows users to create, publish, and manage websites without coding.

product.name: Studio CMS
product.description: A content management system integrated within Studio.Design for collaborative content creation and management without external tools.

product.name: Studio Hosting
product.description: A hosting service integrated with Studio.Design that publishes websites with one click, requiring no coding or server configuration.

product.name: Studio Form Builder
product.description: A no-code form creation tool within Studio.Design that allows users to design and implement customizable forms with control over styling and animations.

product.name: Studio SEO Settings
product.description: A set of tools within Studio.Design for configuring SEO parameters like redirects, sitemaps, and meta tags on a per-content basis.

product.name: Studio Site Management
product.description: Features for website management including backup, user permissions, and security measures within Studio.Design.
